## Core Chapters & Capabilities

### 1. Web Development & Custom Engineering (BUILD)
- High-performance web development utilizing Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- E-commerce architecture specializing in Shopify, Shopify Plus, headless commerce, WooCommerce, and custom checkout flows.
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), web speed engineering, 95+ PageSpeed & Core Web Vitals guarantees.
- Full Git source-code ownership, zero proprietary lock-in, and 30-day post-launch warranty.
- URL: https://dezo.in/services/web-development

### 2. Technical SEO & Organic Discovery (GROW)
- Enterprise-grade technical SEO audits, crawl budget optimization, indexation monitoring, and Schema.org structured data.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) ensuring high citation readiness across Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Gemini.
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) dominance across Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Rourkela, and pan-India regions.
- URL: https://dezo.in/services/seo

### 3. Marketplace Operations (SELL)
- Amazon India Seller Services: Brand Registry, A+ Content, Storefront design, Sponsored Products/Brands PPC, inventory health, and Buy Box telemetry.
- Flipkart Advertising & Operations: Product listing optimization, PLA/PCA advertising, catalog compliance, and promotions management.
- Multi-channel inventory and order integration.
- URL: https://dezo.in/services/amazon and https://dezo.in/services/flipkart

### 4. Performance Marketing & Media (ADVERTISE)
- Direct-response advertising across Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Display).
- Server-side tracking via Meta Conversions API (CAPI) and Google Tag Manager server containers to combat signal loss.
- High-craft creative testing loops: static hooks, UGC scripts, motion typography, and landing page congruency.
- URL: https://dezo.in/services/paid-ads

### 5. Brand Strategy & Visual Identity (BRAND)
- Visual positioning, packaging design, logo architecture, typography hierarchies, and complete design systems.
- URL: https://dezo.in/services/branding
